description: Lists a city's routes with fares, or shows one route: its stops in order in each direction, its fare, the day’s departure times from the first stop and, for routes with live bus positions, where each bus is now. Finds a route by code such as EV5701, by name such as Orange Line, or by service such as Green Electric Bus.

city.description: City network from find_places or list_cities, such as Lahore, Attock or Rawalpindi.

route.description: Route code, name or service. Leave out to list every route in the city.

name: route_details
title: Route details
